pin: NONE -- the CNF carries no symmetry break and no selector variable

geometry.arithmetic: exact, in Q(sqrt3, sqrt11) 4-slot Fractions; no floating point
geometry.cross_edge_note: the L-S class is re-derived from CrossLaw's stated derivation, not by calling the committed edge builder

refutation.solver: cadical 2.1.2 (the toolchain binary, a separate process)

lrat.checker: tools/parts_edge_verify.py:check_lrat, RUP with hints, written for this verification and sharing no code with CaDiCaL or pysat

c2_minus_one_kept_edge.solver: cadical 2.1.2 (the toolchain binary, a separate process)

c3_minus_one_vertex.solver: cadical 2.1.2 (the toolchain binary, a separate process)

not_the_minimum: a greedy 1-minimal pass is order-dependent; this is an edge-reduced object at an exact count and an UPPER bound on the edge minimum, never the minimum, which is a hitting set and a different question
not_yet_a_record: M63 §S.1 #4: a beat is called a record only once certified in the Lean kernel (UDCert plus the LRAT chain on exact geometry). Until then this is a number, not a record.
